verdicts.title: Analysis of Titles and Readers For Title Generation Centered on the Readers
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The title of a document has two roles, to give a compact summary and to lead the reader to read the document. Conventional title generation focuses on finding key expressions from the author's wording in the document to give a compact summary and pays little attention to the reader's interest.
